name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: Standing calf raise building the gastrocnemius for lower leg development.
setup: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, balls of feet on edge of step or flat floor.
execution: Press through balls of feet raising heels as high as possible, hold 1 second, lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale on raise, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
description: Seated calf raise targeting the soleus for lower leg thickness.
setup: Sit on bench, dumbbell on knee, balls of feet on floor or elevated surface.
execution: Raise heels as high as possible, squeeze calves, lower with full stretch.
breathing: Exhale on raise, inhale on lower
progression: Heavier weight or pause at top

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: Unilateral calf raise correcting imbalances and building definition.
setup: Stand on one leg holding dumbbell, other foot lifted behind.
execution: Raise heel as high as possible, hold 1 second, lower with full stretch.
breathing: Exhale on raise, inhale on lower

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
description: Unilateral seated raise isolating the soleus per leg.
setup: Sit on bench, one dumbbell on working knee, foot on elevated surface.
execution: Raise heel high, squeeze, lower to full stretch.
breathing: Exhale on raise, inhale on lower
